intent: Inspect admitted datum planes and create a new named sketch on feature:datum using the typed sketch creation tools. Keep its authored datum association. Create ent:new_center at local 0 mm, 0 mm and an ellipse ent:new_ellipse with semiaxes 20 mm / 10 mm and angle 0 deg through the typed sketch editor. Extrude it as a 6 mm new body feature:new_datum_body. Set param:offset to 15 mm through a DesignPatch, then edit the center to local 2 mm, -3 mm with current document identity/revision. Preserve all prior feature/sketch/semantic source and other parameters. Use sketch:new_1 and feature:sketch_new_1; verify source, world placement and Undo/Redo. Do not copy a custom frame over the datum reference.
steps: plan_sketch_create with datum_plane:feature:datum and no plane or frame
apply_sketch_create with current document_id and revision
inspect_sketches; plan_sketch_edit / apply_sketch_edit with document_id and explicit local units
plan_feature_edit / apply_feature_edit for the 6 mm new body
patch_apply param:offset=15 mm; inspect again before the local point edit
export_document; independently grade exact source association, world bounds, centroid and volume
Agent opencad.history_undo_document / opencad.history_redo_document or native UI Undo/Redo restore original parameter expressions, IDs and datum dependencies
compatibility: Source fields/tags unchanged. Datum editing requires document identity. Use a build from this checkout; published v0.3.1 predates these typed APIs.
